method: Developer-informed synthetic cognitive walkthrough and shared-selector trace. Scenario checkpoints are constructed; no novice participant or blind agent is represented.
limits: Prior source knowledge cannot be erased. No measured human attention, comprehension, enjoyment, error probability or completion time.
Constructed checkpoints and supplied inventory are not a normal-play progression or balance run. No campaign saves are read or written.
Browser observations are recorded separately; source traces do not establish control discoverability.

benefits.complex: Unlock the Final Core recipe. Unlock the Yin and Yang recipes. Reveal all four corner locations. Reaching them still requires ordinary map expansion.

findings.observation: The old promotion clue used the assembly wording before any corner pieces were available.
findings.remedy: Give Complex upgrade its own chassis clue.

findings.observation: When all pieces were owned but halves were missing, the old fallback pointed to Final Core assembly.
findings.remedy: Use the existing Final Core clue with a combining-pieces phase and the world-matching missing-half recipe; switch to Final Core only once both halves are owned.

findings.observation: After the Assembler consumes both halves, a running Final Core batch could be mistaken for missing supply and send guidance back to corners.
findings.remedy: Keep Final Core assembly guidance during a committed Final Core batch; pairing regressions cover the consumed-input interval.

findings.observation: Revealed corner locations could be mistaken for opened destinations.
findings.remedy: State ordinary expansion is still required in upgrade benefits and the locked-corner detail panel.

findings.observation: A newcomer may not discover recipe inspection or identify the relevant Assembler when Show me is deliberately absent.
findings.nextCheck: Observe recipe-guide discovery and delivery planning without coaching in a participant session.

findings.observation: World-owned pieces and halves can be spread across maps; ownership does not establish delivery to the same Assembler.
findings.nextCheck: Include a distributed-stock checkpoint in human observation; inspect ordinary missing-input feedback.

proposedParticipantProtocol.success: Uncoached task completion and accurate explanation at each encountered checkpoint. No result claimed until real participants are observed.
